featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - October 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official October Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Daugavpils, traveling through the Baltic area to end in Saint Petersburg.

The event takes place on the **24th October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P2n_zTokGmtO6)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38163.1790793179.png)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Daugavpils** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](hhttps://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121230-official-ets2-convoy-october-2026/)**!
featured.rule:
**Event Rules for Participants**  
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
* Participants should park at their designated slots, which is any non-collision company in Daugavpils.  
* Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants must haul a trailer during the convoy. 
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited.
* Cars including alternating vehicles are prohibited except for TruckersMP Event Staff assisting with the event. 
* Buses are prohibited.
* Overtaking is strictly prohibited.  
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* All other [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.  

**Event Rules for Event Staff**  
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.  
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
* All other [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.

departure.location: Any City in The play area

arrive.location: Any City in The play area

featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.
	 
 # You can park in any city within the play area

today.name: China Friendship Team October Event
today.description:
中国友谊团队于2025年6月4日正式重组。团队始终秉持“共同发展、互助协作”的初心，汇聚了多支创始车队。在团队中，成员之间始终保持密切交流与无私帮助，不仅多次开展内部经验分享，更致力于构建一个携手共进的发展共同体。

尽管团队在成立初期经历了一些磨合与挑战，但凭借坚定的信念与不断的努力，大家逐渐融合为一个紧密团结的整体。在每一次大型活动中，我们都会认真总结经验、查找不足，并共同探讨优化方案，从而持续提升活动的流畅度与参与体验。

多支车队均为团队的创始成员，彼此之间没有高低之分，始终保持着平等沟通、协同决策的良好氛围，共创团队美好未来。

today.name: WITH ANIMALS FROM JUTLAND TO SCANDINAVIA!
today.description:
## WITH ANIMALS FROM JUTLAND TO SCANDINAVIA!
- Se zvířaty z Jutska do srdce Skandinávie!
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/KYjgumH.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. Cargo is limited for the animal trailers - pigs, cows.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)


-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **18:00**  - Meetup at Aalborg (primary), or Esbjerg slots.
*  **18:30** -  Departure from the Esbjerg and Aalbrog.
*  **18:45** -  Meetup of both convoys on the route E20.
*  **18:55**  - Passage over Øresund Bridge - Denmark.
*  **19:05**  - Passage around the city of Malmö.
*  **19:10**  - Pause at the gas station near Malmö.
*  **19:20** -  Departure from the pause!
*  **19:45** -  Final Photo and end of the convoy!

![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/7YBRGod.png)

-----

* **1. Aalborg, Freyr - Jönköping, Freyr.**
* **2. Esbjerg, Freyr - Jönköping, Freyr.**

To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.
4. Our management will confirm your registration through the ticket.

today.name: Oktober Konvoi Der Fire Phoenix
today.description:
Wir starten um 20 Uhr unseren Oktober Monatskonvoi auf den Türkischen Straßen von Edirne aus in Richtung Jassy. (~1.330Km), guckt bitte das ihr rechtzeitig bereit steht und vorm Konvoi Start bitte die LKWs Repariert und Auftankt damit der Start reibungslos ablaufen kann und keine Probleme mit den LKWs unterwegs entstehen können.

Es wird bei diesem Konvoi eine 15 Minütige Pause eingeplant die in Pitesti auf den Speditionen Kaarfor u. Dom Depo Stattfinden wird. 

Folgender DLS ist erforderlich: https://store.steampowered.com/app/227310/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Going_East/?curator_clanid=4419325

Wir Starten von Edirne mit Singletrailer (Maximal 10T Fracht) in Fahrtrichtung Landschaft. 

Zum Abschluss bleiben wir an der Spedition Kaarfor um Paar Gruppenbilder nach der Gemeinsamen fahrt zu machen, dafür Parken/stellen wir die Auflieger ein/zur Seite damit die nicht stören oder im Weg stehen
today.rule:
Es gilten die Standart Konvoi regeln:
- Überholen ist Strickt untersagt. Wenn Fremdfahrer auf der Karte oder im Tab auftauchen sollten, Passieren lassen
- Konvoispitze gibt die Geschwindigkeit an, versucht bitte mindestens 100 Meter zu eurem Vorderman einzuhalten um rechzeitig reagieren zu können (ausweichen/Bremsen)

upcoming.name: TruckersFM11 - Festival #TFM11
upcoming.description:
# **Welcome to TruckersFM's 11th Anniversary Festival! 🎉**
To celebrate TruckersFM turning 11 years old, we're throwing a one-of-a-kind party! Over the weekend, there will be loads to get involved with both in-game, and on-air.  
Want to come and join the celebrations? Dial in the radio to TruckersFM and come join us at our festival!

![TFM11 Festival Map](https://i.ibb.co/yFNvVcvG/tfm11-festival.jpg)

> **Server opens:** 17:00 BST  
**Festival starts:** 18:00 BST  
**Festival ends:** 23:00 BST  
**Location:** TruckersFM 11 City (located near London, UK)

---

At the festival, why not come and get involved with all of our events? There might even be prizes to be won!

## Bash the Bin
**Time:** 18:00 - 20:00 BST  
**Prize(s):** TBC  
Ever played TMP's "Knock the cone"? This is our twist on it! In front of you is a drag strip, with 3 bins lined up in a triangle at the end. The aim of the game is to bash the front bin (marked by the first of the two white lines) WITHOUT bashing the rear two bins (marked by the second of the two white lines). If you bash the rear bins (or cross the second line), you're out! The first to bash the first bin but not the second is the winner!  
![](https://i.ibb.co/RkhpLQj5/eut2-hq-6ac554ee.jpg)

## Off-road track
**Time:** 19:00 - 22:00 BST  
**Prize(s):** TBC  
Are you feeling adventurous? Why not take on the off-road track challenge! In this event, you'll be timed around our specially made off-road course, located in the TFM11 Quarry. There will be many challenges, on this course which will test the limits of your driving skills! You'll want to make a quicksave before taking part, as vehicle damage is guaranteed! How quickly can you get round the course?  
![](https://i.ibb.co/KpH3Tp6D/eut2-hq-6ac557ef.jpg)

## Race Track
**Time:** 20:00 - 23:00 BST  
**Prize(s):** TBC  
The ultimate test of speed! Bring out your fastest truck and race other players on our all new race track! Filled with exciting corners, straights, and lots of space for showing off your speed, the race track will crown the quickest drivers of the night! Be careful though, it's easy to flip a truck if you're cornering too fast!  
![](https://i.ibb.co/ZR4CpZV3/eut2-hq-6ac55888.jpg)

---

And there's so much more fun we haven't mentioned, such as the main stage where you can come and vibe with our staff & partners at TruckersMP! We can't wait to see you there, celebrating 11 Years of broadcasting!

## **[Why not also check out the #TFM11 Convoy?](https://truckersmp.com/events/35194)**

upcoming.name: CONVOY DECEPTICONS TRANSPORTANDO CHATARRA  VALIOSA A MEGATRON
upcoming.description:
El sol de Texas caía con una fuerza implacable sobre el asfalto de la Interestatal 10, pero para el convoy Decepticon, el calor era lo de menos. Los motores modificados de los imponentes camiones pesados rugían en una frecuencia baja y amenazante mientras dejaban atrás los áridos paisajes de Van Horn. Su cargamento no era mercancía ordinaria: transportaban toneladas de chatarra valiosa, restos de tecnología cibertroniana y aleaciones militares de alto secreto recuperadas de una base clandestina en el desierto. Una ofrenda directa para el mismísimo Megatron.
La orden del líder supremo había sido categórica: «Traigan esos componentes intactos. Quien falle en asegurar la carga conocerá mi cañón de fusión».
A la cabeza del convoy, el comandante de la ruta vigilaba los sistemas de radar encriptados a través de TruckersMP. El viaje a través del estado de la estrella solitaria era largo y peligroso; debían cruzar cientos de kilómetros vigilados por las fuerzas de seguridad humanas y, potencialmente, por exploradores Autobot.
—Mantengan la formación en US Simulation y no bajen de las 70 millas por hora —ordenó el líder del convoy por la radio—. Cerca de San Antonio aumentaremos la seguridad. Megatron espera este metal en la costa.
Los camiones devoraban el asfalto de Texas, pasando de los terrenos montañosos del oeste a las llanuras centrales. Las pesadas plataformas, reforzadas con energía oscura, brillaban con un tenue destello morado bajo las luces de los tableros digitales. Cada contenedor iba sellado magnéticamente para ocultar la firma de energía cibertroniana.
Finalmente, tras horas de tensa navegación y esquivar las patrullas fronterizas, el horizonte plano del golfo comenzó a asomarse. El convoy redujo la velocidad al entrar en los sectores industriales de Victoria, Texas, donde los agentes de tierra ya tenían preparado el búnker de descarga. Las compuertas se abrieron para recibir las toneladas de metal que servirían para forjar el nuevo armamento del ejército Decepticon. La misión en Texas había sido un éxito rotundo.
